purpose: Strengthen BE completion provenance for the existing 6 September 2026 OPEC+ voluntary-adjustment review using newly available Saudi Press Agency official participating-government confirmation, while retaining Reuters fallback history and keeping competent OPEC primary outcome provenance pending.

selection.official_confirmation_title: Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, and Oman Reaffirm Commitment to Market Stability

target.canonical_name: OPEC+ voluntary-adjustment review — seven participating countries

official_confirmation_source.endpoint_role: Official participating-government confirmation of the 6 September 2026 seven-country OPEC+ review and announced October production decision; supporting completion provenance only, not competent OPEC issuing authority
official_confirmation_source.information_supplied: SPA records that Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria and Oman met virtually on 6 September 2026 and decided to maintain September 2026 required production for October 2026. Used as official participating-government confirmation while competent OPEC primary outcome provenance remains pending.
official_confirmation_source.future_schedule_horizon: post-event official confirmation only; no future occurrence may be created from this source without separate competent schedule review
official_confirmation_source.recommended_verification_cadence: none; retain as reviewed supporting provenance and continue seeking competent OPEC primary outcome source
official_confirmation_source.licence_constraints: No broad republication or automated retrieval rights are inferred from public HTML availability; retain only minimal factual metadata, source identity and link.
official_confirmation_source.rights_summary: BG uses SPA as a manually reviewed official participating-government confirmation. Public accessibility does not grant production automation or broad reuse rights.
official_confirmation_source.rights_review_note: Operational WORLD SIGNALS source-governance classification; not legal advice.
known_limitations: SPA is an official Saudi government news agency but is not the competent OPEC issuing institution.
The SPA publication timestamp is source-publication time and must not be promoted to canonical event time.
Current accessible/indexed OPEC surfaces reviewed for BG did not expose the 6 September outcome; absence is not evidence that no OPEC statement exists.
The competent OPEC primary provenance requirement remains REQUIRED_WHEN_RETRIEVABLE.
Reuters WSSRC-COM-015 must remain preserved in historical provenance because it was the evidence used for BE completion.
The 4 October date in SPA is not forward-schedule authority for this source and BG creates no occurrence from it.
official_confirmation_source.notes: Official participating-government completion confirmation only. WSSRC-COM-001 remains the governed OPEC schedule/decision authority; Reuters fallback remains in history; competent OPEC outcome provenance remains pending.

provenance_basis.review_reason: Newly available Saudi Press Agency official evidence confirms that the seven participating OPEC+ countries met on 6 September 2026 and announced unchanged October production requirements. This materially improves completion provenance relative to the Reuters fallback but does not satisfy the competent OPEC-primary requirement.
